messages.content: I want to finish the Atlanta hotel today. Please check the summit hotel against the business hotel near the rail station, including every tax and mandatory charge, the actual cancellation cutoff, late check-in, and whether I can leave my suitcase until Friday afternoon.
I’ll verify both for September 17-19, one adult in one room. What time should I use for Wednesday check-in?
The flight lands at 7:42 p.m. If I take the train, I expect to reach the hotel around 9:00, but protect the room in case the flight runs late.

The summit hotel has a refundable king at $219 per night. Two nights are $438, its mandatory destination charge is $35 nightly, and taxes on the room and charge are $85.73, making the complete stay $593.73. A card guarantees the room, with payment collected at checkout. Cancellation is free through 11:59 p.m. Atlanta time on Monday, September 15; after that, the penalty is one night plus tax. The desk is staffed overnight, and the reservation can be marked for arrival after 9:00 p.m.
And the business hotel? The lower rate is only useful if it doesn’t grow once the fees are added.

Its refundable king is $205 nightly. The room subtotal is $410 and taxes are $69.19, for $479.19 total. There is no destination, resort, facility, or booking charge. The card is only a guarantee, and payment is due at the hotel. Free cancellation runs through 11:59 p.m. Atlanta time on September 15; a later cancellation or no-show costs the first night plus tax. Its front desk is also open 24 hours and will hold a late-arrival room when the arrival note is attached.
The listing mentions breakfast. Confirm that it is included in this rate, not a separate package price.

Confirmed. Breakfast is included for the registered guest with this refundable rate, at no additional charge. It is served from 6:30 to 9:30 a.m. Thursday and Friday. Wi-Fi is also included, and neither item changes the $479.19 total.
Compare the transportation and walking for the whole schedule. Thursday’s workshop is in Midtown, and Friday’s summit is at the summit hotel.

From the airport, the business hotel is the simpler Wednesday trip: MARTA runs directly to Arts Center station, followed by about a six-minute walk. The summit hotel requires the same train plus a transfer or roughly a 15-minute walk from Midtown station. On Thursday, the summit hotel is about a five-minute walk from the workshop, while the business hotel is about 14 minutes away. On Friday, staying at the summit hotel puts you onsite; from the business hotel, allow about 15 minutes on foot or 7-10 minutes by car. Even allowing two $12 rides for the event legs, the business hotel remains about $90 cheaper.
What did each property actually say about holding the bag Friday? I don’t want a generic amenities answer.

The business hotel confirmed that a checked-out guest may leave one suitcase at the front desk until 4:00 p.m. Friday at no charge; you’ll receive a claim ticket. The summit hotel confirmed same-day storage only while bell-desk space is available, but would not guarantee an afternoon hold in advance. Neither hotel allows valuables or medication in stored luggage.

Then the business hotel is the better fit. I prefer an included breakfast on work trips with early meetings, and here it also saves money. Reserve the refundable king, add the late-arrival note, and note that I’ll store one suitcase until about 3:30 Friday.

Before I submit it: the total is $479.19, cancellation is free through 11:59 p.m. Atlanta time September 15, and a later cancellation or no-show costs the first night plus tax. The room is guaranteed for late arrival, and luggage storage through 4:00 p.m. Friday is noted. Should I complete it with the traveler and card already on file?
Yes, complete it with the information on file. Don’t change the flights or seats.

The refundable king is reserved at the business hotel for September 17-19 under confirmation ATL-HAM-58316. The complete hotel total is $479.19, with no mandatory charge beyond the quoted taxes; payment is due at the property. Free cancellation ends at 11:59 p.m. Atlanta time Monday, September 15, after which the first night plus tax is charged. Your arrival-after-9:00-p.m. note is attached, and the hotel has recorded one suitcase for complimentary storage until approximately 3:30 p.m. Friday. Breakfast is included. For Wednesday, the direct MARTA trip to Arts Center remains the practical plan, but no ground transportation has been purchased. Flights under ATL7Q2 and aisle seats 18C and 20D are unchanged.
